lines.en: Once upon a time, there lived a kind-hearted girl.
segs: Once upon a time, there lived a kind-hearted girl.

lines.en: You work in the kitchen!
Ashy girl! Ashy girl!
So the girl was called Cinderella.
segs: So the girl was called Cinderella.

lines.text: 어느 날, 궁전에서 무도회 편지가 왔어요.
lines.en: One day, a letter came from the palace. There was a ball!
segs: One day, a letter came from the palace. There was a ball!

lines.text: 신데렐라, 내 머리 좀 예쁘게 해 줘!
lines.en: Cinderella, do my hair nicely!
Yes, I will make it pretty.
segs: Yes, I will make it pretty.

lines.en: Tap your sister's hair!
Oh, how pretty!
The sisters happily went off to the ball.
segs: The sisters happily went off to the ball.

lines.en: Cinderella, left all alone, sobbed and sobbed.
segs: Cinderella, left all alone, sobbed and sobbed.

lines.en: I wish I could go to the ball, too.
segs: I wish I could go to the ball, too.

lines.en: Then her fairy godmother appeared.

lines.text: 울지 마렴. 너도 무도회에 가고 싶지? 내가 도와주마.
lines.en: Don't cry, dear. You want to go to the ball, don't you? I will help you.
segs: Don't cry, dear. You want to go to the ball, don't you? I will help you.

lines.en: Bring me the biggest pumpkin from the garden.
segs: Bring me the biggest pumpkin from the garden.

lines.en: Tap the pumpkin!
The pumpkin turned into a golden coach!
segs: The pumpkin turned into a golden coach!

lines.en: There are mice in the trap. How many are there?
segs: There are mice in the trap. How many are there?

lines.en: Tap the mousetrap!

lines.text: 생쥐가 여섯 마리! 하얀 말 여섯 마리가 되었어요.
lines.en: Six mice! They became six white horses.
segs: Six mice! They became six white horses.

lines.text: 큰 쥐는 마부가, 도마뱀은 시종이 되었어요.
lines.en: The big rat became the coachman, and the lizards became footmen.
segs: The big rat became the coachman, and the lizards became footmen.

lines.en: Now it is your turn, dear.
segs: Now it is your turn, dear.

lines.text: 신데렐라는 은빛 드레스에 유리 구두를 신었어요.
lines.en: Cinderella wore a silver gown and glass slippers.
segs: Cinderella wore a silver gown and glass slippers.

lines.en: Oh, thank you so much!

lines.text: 꼭 기억하렴. 밤 열두 시가 되면 마법이 풀린단다.
lines.en: Remember, dear. At midnight, the magic will end.
segs: Remember, dear. At midnight, the magic will end.

lines.en: Yes, I will remember!
When she arrived at the palace, everyone stared at Cinderella.
segs: When she arrived at the palace, everyone stared at Cinderella.

lines.en: Please, dance with me.
Cinderella shared oranges with her sisters, too.
segs: Cinderella shared oranges with her sisters, too.

lines.en: Oh, thank you!
The sisters did not know who she was.
segs: The sisters did not know who she was.

lines.text: 시계를 보니 열두 시가 가까워요. 신데렐라는 약속대로 집에 돌아왔어요.
lines.en: The clock said it was almost midnight. Cinderella went home, just as she promised.
segs: The clock said it was almost midnight. Cinderella went home, just as she promised.

lines.en: The next night, there was another ball.
segs: The next night, there was another ball.

lines.text: 신데렐라는 춤추느라 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요.
lines.en: Cinderella was dancing so happily that she forgot the time.
segs: Cinderella was dancing so happily that she forgot the time.

lines.text: 긴 바늘과 짧은 바늘이 모두 12를 가리키면 열두 시예요. 열두 시 시계를 찾아봐요!
lines.en: When the long hand and the short hand both point to twelve, it is twelve o'clock. Find the clock that says twelve!
segs: When the long hand and the short hand both point to twelve, it is twelve o'clock. Find the clock that says twelve!

lines.en: Find the clock that says twelve!
segs: Find the clock that says twelve!

lines.en: That is three o'clock.
That is six o'clock.

lines.text: 바늘이 모두 위로 올라가면 열두 시예요.
lines.en: When both hands point straight up, it is twelve o'clock.
segs: When both hands point straight up, it is twelve o'clock.

lines.en: That's right, twelve o'clock!
Oh no, it's twelve o'clock!

lines.text: 신데렐라는 계단을 달려 내려가다 유리 구두 한 짝을 떨어뜨렸어요.
lines.en: Cinderella ran down the stairs and lost one glass slipper.
segs: Cinderella ran down the stairs and lost one glass slipper.

lines.text: 이 구두가 꼭 맞는 사람을 찾을 거예요.
lines.en: I will find the person this slipper fits.
segs: I will find the person this slipper fits.

lines.text: 왕자님이 유리 구두를 들고 집집마다 찾아다녔어요.
lines.en: The prince carried the glass slipper from house to house.
segs: The prince carried the glass slipper from house to house.

lines.en: My foot will fit!
My foot will fit, too!

lines.text: 언니들의 발은 너무 커서 들어가지 않았어요.
lines.en: The sisters' feet were too big, and the slipper would not fit.
segs: The sisters' feet were too big, and the slipper would not fit.

lines.en: May I try it on, too?
segs: May I try it on, too?

lines.en: Find the foot that is the same size as the slipper!
segs: Find the foot that is the same size as the slipper!

lines.en: That foot is bigger than the slipper.
segs: That foot is bigger than the slipper.

lines.en: That's right, the small foot!
The slipper fit perfectly!

lines.text: 신데렐라는 주머니에서 다른 한 짝을 꺼냈어요.
lines.en: Cinderella took the other slipper out of her pocket.
segs: Cinderella took the other slipper out of her pocket.

lines.text: 요정 대모가 다시 고운 옷을 입혀 주었어요.
lines.en: Her fairy godmother dressed her in a beautiful gown again.
segs: Her fairy godmother dressed her in a beautiful gown again.

lines.en: Cinderella, we are sorry for all that time. We are truly sorry.
segs: Cinderella, we are sorry for all that time.

lines.en: It's all right. Let's be happy together.
segs: It's all right. Let's be happy together.

lines.en: Tap to say hello to Cinderella!
segs: Tap to say hello to Cinderella!

lines.en: Everyone laughed together.

lines.text: 착한 마음은 나를 괴롭힌 사람도 용서할 수 있어요.
lines.en: A kind heart can forgive even those who were unkind to us.
segs: A kind heart can forgive even those who were unkind to us.
